posts.cooked:
Spoilers for the Tempest episode

 

So, we learned today how Maerynian's reproduce.

We learned that they can take genetic information from people that they come in contact with while carrying an egg.

We learned that Tempest is currently carrying an egg.

 

So if tempest comes into contact with young Legacy, and gets some of her genetic information, would his offspring get the powers of the Legacy line? Would it then stop Paulina's first born child from being able to inherit that legacy?

As much as I'm usually loathe to go meta, I feel the answer to this basically hinges on "Would Christopher be twisted enough to go with this?"

And now I'm stymied by the fact that I don't actually have an answer for that.

Related thoughts: "Is twisted the right word? I mean this wouldn't actually be the most horrible thing ever from a strictly objective perspective." + "Didn't Christopher once allude to there being lots of people with Legacy-esque powers at some point in the distant future?"
